scenes.text: Seven new formulas hit your skin barrier at once. When it reacts, there's no way to know which one did it.
So, one new product at a time. Two weeks apart. And patch test it behind your ear first.
Okay. One at a time. Got it.
Follow for more skin mistakes. Kobi launches November twenty fifth.

caption:
Skin Mistakes, ep. 1: 7 new products in one night 😳
Mina tried her whole haul at once. The next morning: redness and bumps, and no way to know which product did it.
The rule: one new product at a time, two weeks apart, patch test behind the ear first.
Save this before your next haul.
Kobi launches 25 Nov. Waitlist in bio.
